clips.title: The story
paras: This early mission from Executor Arren tasks newly awakened Forsaken with ambushing a nearby camp of Scarlet Crusade zealots southeast of Deathknell. It serves as a grim introduction to one of the Forsaken's most fanatical and persistent enemies.

Once the immediate peril of the Night Web spider infestation is handled, Executor Arren turns Deathknell's attention toward an encroaching threat. A detachment of the Scarlet Crusade has established a foothold just southeast of the settlement. These zealots refuse to acknowledge any distinction between mindless Scourge minions and free-willed Forsaken, meaning their presence on the border poses an existential threat to the newly risen dead.

Understanding that dialogue is impossible with holy fanatics who view all dead flesh as an abomination, Arren orders a preemptive strike. Adventurers are sent to cut down Scarlet Initiates and Converts before the encampment can grow into an organized forward assault on Deathknell. The trophies brought back—their crimson armbands—stand as stark proof that survival in Tirisfal must be claimed by force.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: You'll be happy to know we appear to be making progress in the mine, thanks in no small part to your efforts. We can now turn our eyes to other concerns.

My scouts have reported that a detachment of the Scarlet Crusade is setting up a camp southeast of here. The Scarlet Crusade is a despicable organization that hunts us, and they will not rest until every undead--Lich King's Scourge or no—is destroyed. We must strike first!
Be careful, their unholy zeal makes them dangerous adversaries.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Those fools... They happily send themselves to their own graves.

clips.title: Completion
paras: If only they listened to reason, eh, friend? Perhaps we could sit them down for reasonable discourse... Ha!
